result.title: BluePixel: Toward Native 4K Agentic Image Editing
result.summary: Instruction-driven image editing has reached native 4K, yet how such editors are trained remains undisclosed, and pretraining one from scratch is beyond most teams. The task itself compounds the difficulty: a single end-to-end editor cannot make precise parametric adjustments, match specialized experts, or interpret the vague instructions users actually write. We argue that 4K editing is a system problem rather than a single-model problem, and present BluePixel, which couples a native-4K editing model with an agent harness; the complete training recipe is disclosed in this paper. The model makes 4K training practical: it turns a 1K-pretrained editor into a native-4K one through progressive VAE adaptation that keeps 4K training as affordable as 1K, absorbs a long tail of vertical editing skills through continual learning, and refines the aesthetic-fidelity trade-off with reinforcement learning. Distillation via source-anchored target projection (SATP) then compresses 50 denoising steps to 4, completing a 4K edit in 8.7 s on a single Kunlunxin P800 XPU while preserving task success rate and background consistency. The harness, BluePixel Agent, makes editing controllable: it decomposes user instructions into specialist and general operations, verifies every result with the same reward model that guided training, and retries within bounded attempts. On VINS-4KEval++ (3,305 native-4K cases), BluePixel ranks second among seven models, behind only GPT Image 2 in non-edited-region consistency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 BluePixel，把原生 4K 指令图像编辑当作系统问题：一侧是 4K 编辑模型（渐进 VAE 适配、持续学习、强化学习调优、SATP 蒸馏把 50 步去噪压到 4 步），另一侧是 agent harness（把指令分解为专项与通用操作、用同一奖励模型验证结果并在有界次数内重试）。
AI.relevance_reason: 该 agent harness 的「分解—奖励模型验证—有界重试」决策闭环，可能为 LVR 中的验证、贡献分配与停止决策提供可核查的外部参照，但任务是图像编辑，迁移价值需人工判断。
